source.document: Buscopan tablets and injection prescribing information

key_sections_summary: Tabs 10–20 mg, max 60 mg/d; inj 10–20 mg, max 100 mg/d; no renal wording; oral F <1%; IV ~50% unchanged urine; PB 4.4%; t1/2 ~5 h IV.
note: Our paraphrase of the regulator product information; numbers copied exactly. Not rendered as text.
